description: ÖPNV - Bike-and-Ride-Stationen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Dieser Datensatz enthält die Positionen aller Bike-and-Ride-Stationen im Stadtgebiet Münster. Enthalten darin sind auch die sogenannten "Leezenboxen". Dort kann man sein Fahrrad sicher parken, teilweise gibt es auch Schließfächer mit Stromanschluss. Die Daten wurden bereitgestellt von den Stadtwerken Münster. Sie finden diese Daten auch in unserm Github-Repository. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are transport-und-verkehr. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
